required_shape.external_data: Only immutable current typed fixture parameter and direct onEvent callback; bridge is stateless decode/passthrough.
required_shape.internal_state: Only finite synchronous component-owned decisions, receipts and published same-entity revalidation / changed-entity reset. No external async source or generated synthetic expectation.
required_shape.vertical_layout: One eager finite vertical flow filling actual offered child width; no lazy children, nested/internal scrolling, overlay, popup, navigation, timer, animation or data-dependent off-domain surface.
required_shape.host: Exact shared native host/provider, requested390x600 logical viewport, horizontal inset16/top24, light/LTR; actual width/viewport independently verified. iOSLarge; Androidfont_scale1.0,density2.75 and paparazzi-float32-screen-config-v1.
required_shape.scope: Only exact sealed public/private fixture families and original action prefixes, never arbitrary future callers.

required_later_evidence: Independent actual production-source review against API/placement/rules/minimal static local tags.
Actual bridge bytes identical to approved thin bridge, source ownership and identity reset component-owned.
Independent exact provider/host approval, geometry encoding and environment pin.
Fresh actual compile action/log/compiled-host identity bound to installed production subject+bridge, not an unused matching copy.
Separate matching immutable domain records for each public/hidden design lock/plan after real source exists.
Runtime viewport, source/fixture/input/process/event bindings and full-state coverage observed; no inherited pass across replacement or targeted state.
rejection_conditions: Source/bridge differs from pinned approved revisions.
Any unapproved asynchronous/lazy/nested-scroll/overlay shape or hidden input expectation embedded in production.
Missing actual compile/host/source evidence or self-entered labels used as source approval.
Missing coverage witnesses, exact geometry/PNG identities or binding coherence; retain U instead of waiving.
restriction: This rubric cannot grant runtime coverage or source approval now. Builder source approval must be performed later; any repair revision requires new source-domain review and fresh native checks.
